audit: 2026-09-14 scheduled remote agent (second fire of the day): one 50-question batch spanning all four modules and the three active tiers (20 L3, 20 L4, 10 L5). Module split Psychiatry 13, Medicine 13, Paediatrics 12, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 12, chosen so all four modules finish level at 1461 after the earlier fire left Paediatrics and Obstetrics and Gynaecology one ahead. Clusters were picked by keyword probe of subtopic_detail against the live bank and then filtered against the four batches already published today, which forced replacement of three planned questions (puerperal necrotising perineal infection, postpartum enoxaparin dose banding and refugee interpreter selection) that would have duplicated them. Coverage added: Paediatrics on mumps exclusion, molluscum, haemophilia joint bleed, constitutional pubertal delay, paediatric tuberculosis contact, posterior fossa tumour, cerebral palsy hip surveillance, slipped capital femoral epiphysis, oesophageal atresia, fragile X, renal tumour imaging sequencing and Pierre Robin airway escalation; Obstetrics and Gynaecology on trichomoniasis, recurrent candidiasis, Bartholin abscess, syphilis seroconversion, postmenopausal osteoporosis, adenomyosis, polyhydramnios, isolated oligohydramnios, valproate in early pregnancy, peripartum cardiomyopathy, mechanical valve anticoagulation and Asherman syndrome; Psychiatry on tic disorder, body dysmorphic disorder, hoarding, excoriation disorder, varenicline in schizophrenia, lithium-associated hyperparathyroidism, Huntington irritability, narcolepsy, synthetic cannabinoid behavioural disturbance, intellectual disability behaviour change, family intervention for relapse, frontotemporal dementia presenting forensically and the guardianship versus mental health act pathway; Medicine on haemochromatosis, hereditary angioedema, cystic fibrosis exacerbation, obstructive sleep apnoea and commercial driving, Loefgren syndrome, myelodysplasia, Wilson disease, Lambert-Eaton syndrome, thalassaemia trait, carcinoid syndrome, cardiac amyloidosis, acute porphyria and voluntary assisted dying. No L2 generated. scripts/dupe_gate.py passed with zero duplicates on the first run. Correct-answer letters are exactly even at 10 per letter and all tags were normalised to the existing vocabulary. Standing note for the maintainer, unchanged from the previous fire: raw argmax over the 12 cells still never selects an L5 cell, because the frozen legacy L2 stock leaves every L3 and L4 cell with a 12 to 15 point deficit against L5's 0.4 to 0.5, so the batch followed the stated per-batch L5 aim instead; the selection rule needs an explicit L5 floor or an L2-excluded denominator to be self-consistent.
